summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 11 September 2026 confirming open-market repurchases of its ordinary shares executed by broker Goldman Sachs International under two existing buyback programmes announced 30 January 2026 and 31 July 2026. Between 07–11 September 2026 the company bought roughly 73.7 million shares at volume-weighted prices of 109.65–113.28 pence; purchases under the July programme were zero. All shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Watch execution pace versus programme capacity and any shortening of the regulatory buyback window.
